name: Baga Beach
description: Baga Beach is one of the most popular beaches in North Goa. It is known for water sports, beach shacks, nightlife and a lively atmosphere.

name: Calangute Beach
description: Calangute Beach is a large and popular beach in North Goa with water activities, restaurants and shopping nearby.

name: Fort Aguada
description: Fort Aguada is a historic Portuguese fort overlooking the Arabian Sea. It offers scenic views and is a good destination for history and photography.

name: Dudhsagar Waterfalls
description: Dudhsagar Waterfalls is a spectacular waterfall surrounded by forests. It is popular for nature experiences, trekking and adventure.

name: Anjuna Beach
description: Anjuna Beach is known for a relaxed atmosphere, rocky coastline, sunset views and nearby nightlife.

name: Marine Drive
description: Marine Drive is a famous seaside boulevard in Mumbai known for sunset views, evening walks and the city's iconic skyline.

name: Gateway of India
description: The Gateway of India is one of Mumbai's most recognizable landmarks and is located near the waterfront.

name: Elephanta Caves
description: Elephanta Caves are ancient rock-cut caves containing important sculptures and temples. Visitors reach the island by ferry from Mumbai.

name: Lalbagh Botanical Garden
description: Lalbagh Botanical Garden is a large green space in Bengaluru featuring diverse plants, walking paths and a historic glasshouse.

name: Cubbon Park
description: Cubbon Park is a large urban park in Bengaluru suitable for walking, relaxing and spending time outdoors.
